title: FerriteCAD release package manifest
description: The machine-readable description of one release archive of 21A-2b2b1a. It names the files that build produced, what each of them hashes to and which component owns it, and it separates the runtime layout from the package metadata carried beside it. It is not an SBOM and does not describe components: the product SBOM travels in the same archive, byte for byte as it was committed, and this document points at it.

sourceRevision.description: The commit of this repository the packaged binaries were built from, handed to the packager rather than worked out by it. Two archives carrying one product version and two revisions are two products, and before format 2 nothing in a package could tell them apart.

root.description: The one top-level directory the archive extracts into. Its name carries the product version and the target triple so two of them can sit in a directory together.

runtimeFiles.description: The relocatable runtime layout, at the relative paths tools/stage-runtime-layout.sh gave it. Nothing here is renamed or moved by packaging.

packageMetadata.description: The files a release carries so that it can be described rather than so that it can run. Deliberately a separate list: a runtime file filed here would be shipped without anything saying the product needs it in order to start.

hashed.description: A manifest cannot carry the digest of its own bytes: writing it would change them. This is the only exception in the document and it is declared here so a checker can require exactly one rather than tolerate any.

archiveFormat.description: How the archive was written, so that a recipient repacking the extracted tree can get the same bytes without reading the packager.

relativePath.description: Relative to the archive's one top-level directory, with forward slashes, no leading slash, no parent traversal and no backslash.

executable.description: Measured on the staged file rather than decided from its name, and measured again on the extracted one. An archive that lost this is a package a recipient would have to repair.

ownerRef.description: The bom-ref the owner has in the product SBOM travelling in the same archive. Checked to resolve when the manifest is written; nothing in the SBOM is edited to make it.
